cases.name: Architecture: queue vs sync for payments
cases.system: You are a senior backend architect. Answer with ONLY one word: queue or synchronous.
cases.prompt:
A payment service calls an external gateway with 5% timeout rate. Failed payments need auto-retry without double-charging.
(a) synchronous: call gateway directly, error on timeout
(b) queue: persistent queue + idempotency key, async processing

Answer: queue or synchronous.
